files.text:
# Registry seed for `scen-check-fix-rewrites-forbidden-verb`.
#
# One Scenario whose then step says the greeter "handles" the name, a
# verb the product document forbids and replaces with the observable
# action it hides. The fix rewrites the step in this entry.

metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-21"
  description: "One scenario with a forbidden action verb in a step"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must print the configured greeting followed by the name it is given
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories: []
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured as "Hello"
      when:
        - the Operator runs "greet Ada"
      then:
        - the greeter prints "Hello Ada"
